name: MineMeBoost
description: MineMenu and MineBoost in one mod. Right Shift opens a menu with MineMenu (80+ singleplayer cheats on 7 pages: build tools, fun events, utility HUD, creators, morph...) and MineBoost (FPS boost: Render Scale, Lag Doctor, Intel iGPU preset, Idle Mode, A/B test; works alongside Sodium and friends). Ctrl+K opens the Command Palette, . opens MineBoost directly. In English and Portuguese (Portugal).
